mathematical_statement: For P:B→U, form E:=Σ(b:B)P(b) with pr₁:E→B.

agda_declarations.name: total-space
agda_declarations.type: {B : Type ℓ} → (B → Type ℓ′) → Type (ℓ-max ℓ ℓ′)

agda_declarations.name: total-projection
agda_declarations.type: {B : Type ℓ} (P : B → Type ℓ′) → total-space P → B

agda_declarations.name: total-hofib≃
agda_declarations.type: {B : Type ℓ} (P : B → Type ℓ′) (b : B) → fiber (total-projection P) b ≃ P b

agda_declarations.name: transport-map
agda_declarations.type: {B : Type ℓ} (P : B → Type ℓ′) {x y : B} → x ≡ y → P x → P y

mathematical_statement: Transport along p is an equivalence P(x)≃P(y).

agda_declarations.name: transport-equiv
agda_declarations.type: {B : Type ℓ} (P : B → Type ℓ′) {x y : B} → x ≡ y → P x ≃ P y

agda_declarations.name: transport-refl
agda_declarations.type: {B : Type ℓ} (P : B → Type ℓ′) {x : B} (u : P x) → transport-map P refl u ≡ u

notes: A propositional pointwise path, not a claim of function definitional equality.

agda_declarations.name: transport-comp
agda_declarations.type: {B : Type ℓ} (P : B → Type ℓ′) {x y z : B} → (p : x ≡ y) (q : y ≡ z) (u : P x) → transport-map P (p ∙ q) u ≡ transport-map P q (transport-map P p u)

mathematical_statement: mon_{P,b₀}:Ω(B,b₀)→Aut(P(b₀)), with pointwise unit and composition compatibility.

agda_declarations.name: monodromy
agda_declarations.type: {B : Type ℓ} (P : B → Type ℓ′) {b₀ : B} → b₀ ≡ b₀ → Aut (P b₀)

agda_declarations.name: monodromy-map
agda_declarations.type: {B : Type ℓ} (P : B → Type ℓ′) (b₀ : B) → fst (Ω (B , b₀)) → Aut (P b₀)

agda_declarations.name: monodromy-refl
agda_declarations.type: {B : Type ℓ} (P : B → Type ℓ′) {b₀ : B} (u : P b₀) → monodromy P refl .fst u ≡ u

agda_declarations.name: monodromy-comp
agda_declarations.type: {B : Type ℓ} (P : B → Type ℓ′) {b₀ : B} → (p q : b₀ ≡ b₀) (u : P b₀) → monodromy P (p ∙ q) .fst u ≡ monodromy P q .fst (monodromy P p .fst u)

notes: No higher-coherent action and no factorization through π₁ are claimed.

agda_declarations.name: fiber∙
agda_declarations.type: (P : B → Type ℓ′) (b₀ : B) → P b₀ → Pointed ℓ′

agda_declarations.name: transported-point
agda_declarations.type: (f₀ : P b₀) (γ : b₀ ≡ b₀) → P b₀

agda_declarations.name: pointed-monodromy
agda_declarations.type: (f₀ : P b₀) (γ : b₀ ≡ b₀) → fiber∙ P b₀ f₀ ≃∙ fiber∙ P b₀ (transported-point P f₀ γ)

agda_declarations.name: pointed-monodromy-π
agda_declarations.type: (f₀ : P b₀) (γ : b₀ ≡ b₀) (n : ℕ) → GroupEquiv (πGr n (fiber∙ P b₀ f₀)) (πGr n (fiber∙ P b₀ (transported-point P f₀ γ)))

notes: Cubical πGr n presents conventional π_(n+1), hence exactly the stated n≥1 range.

mathematical_statement: Given r:f₁=f₀, obtain the associated based equivalence and group isomorphism.

agda_declarations.name: basepoint-change∙
agda_declarations.type: {A : Type ℓ} (a b : A) → a ≡ b → (A , a) ≃∙ (A , b)

agda_declarations.name: basepoint-change-π
agda_declarations.type: {A : Type ℓ} (a b : A) → (r : a ≡ b) (n : ℕ) → GroupEquiv (πGr n (A , a)) (πGr n (A , b))

notes: The path r is supplied, never assumed to arise canonically from transport.
